input.quote: b) In the event that any occurrence within the scope of the indemnity set forth in 15.1 above is alleged or proved, MSL may, at its sole discretion and at its own expense in order to remedy any such infringement for the future, procure any necessary license rights, or make use of non-infringing designs, processes, Parts, deliverables or other materials, so long as such substitute items do not result in the Products failing to comply with the specifications, requirements, and warranties set forth in this Agreement.
input.rationale: MSL gives IBM a genuine defence-and-indemnity for third-party IP infringement (§ 15.1(a)), with a standard procedure (notice, cooperation, control) and IBM-caused exclusions (IBM-selected marks, IBM written specifications/designs), and there is no reverse IBM indemnity for MSL's services (§ 14 of the Loan Agreement is limited to Loaned Items). Two fallback elements fail on material terms: (i) the procure/modify/replace remedy is discretionary ("MSL may, at its sole discretion") with no refund if no cure is available; and (ii) § 15.3(b) caps "total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action" at 3% of bill-of-materials value, which swallows the indemnity and sits far below the 3X annual fees super-cap. We therefore make the cure remedies mandatory with a refund backstop and carve the indemnity out of the general cap at the fallback super-cap level. We have not sought the preferred additions (data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct, affiliates), which are noted only as short of preferred.

proposal.summary: Make MSL's infringement remedies mandatory with a refund backstop and carve MSL's indemnity out of the 3% liability cap, subject to a 3X annual fees super-cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] MSL's IP indemnity is acceptable, but its cure remedies are discretionary and the whole indemnity is swallowed by the 3% bill-of-materials cap. We make procure/modify/replace mandatory with a refund if none is available, and subject the indemnity to a 3X annual fees super-cap instead of the general cap.
